en.quote: The main, foundational document has been signed—a legally binding memorandum [on Power of Siberia 2].
en.head: “There is no clear timeline yet.”
en.body: On May 20, 2026, after talks between Putin and Xi Jinping, Power of Siberia 2 was absent from the Kremlin’s published list of signed documents. Asked about timing, Peskov replied: “There is no clear timeline yet. This is commercial information, after all.” Media reports said the price and supply terms had not been agreed.

notes: The heading is a shortened rendering of Peskov’s phrase; quote text preserves its qualification.
